mentions.name: Ben Sheppard
mentions.analysis: With Andrew Nembhard out and T.J. McConnell also unavailable, Sheppard is an interesting add due to the lack of available guards on the Pacers.

mentions.name: Dominick Barlow
mentions.analysis: Barlow was streamed for a game but only lasted 12 minutes, making him a drop candidate in most cases.

mentions.name: Isaiah Stewart
mentions.analysis: People added him thinking Jalen Duren might get suspended, but with no suspension news, Stewart is not a must-roster player.

mentions.name: Dillon Brooks
mentions.analysis: Brooks is fine to have taken a flyer on, especially with Jalen Green's return pending.

mentions.name: D'Angelo Russell
mentions.analysis: Russell is the second most dropped player and should never have been on rosters.

mentions.name: Ace Bailey
mentions.analysis: Bailey played only 12 minutes due to illness, and while his role is important, it's worth watching his minutes and performance over the next few games.

mentions.name: Trey Jones
mentions.analysis: With Kobe White out, Jones is a must-add, having delivered a strong performance with 13 points, 5 rebounds, 8 assists, and 5 steals.

mentions.name: Kevin Huerter
mentions.analysis: Huerter is performing well in Kobe White's absence, making him 12-team worthy with his recent performance.

mentions.name: Tyus Jones
mentions.analysis: Jones started in place of Jalen Suggs but was ineffective, making him not worth rostering.

mentions.name: Anthony Black
mentions.analysis: Black had a good game with 19 points, 5 rebounds, and a triple one, making him a potential stream option when Suggs sits.

mentions.name: AJ Mitchell
mentions.analysis: Mitchell had a strong performance with 14 points, 7 rebounds, and 7 assists. He is very good and worth using for now, though long-term viability is uncertain.

mentions.name: Naji Marshall
mentions.analysis: Marshall is benefiting from injuries to other players and is worth rostering while they are out.

mentions.name: Collin Sexton
mentions.analysis: With Brandon Miller potentially out, Sexton will be relied upon more, making him a good pickup.

mentions.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
mentions.analysis: Kalkbrenner is a must-roster player after a strong performance with 14 points, 7 rebounds, and a block.

mentions.name: Moussa Diabate
mentions.analysis: Diabate was not good in his recent game, and with low upside, he is droppable.

mentions.name: Andre Drummond
mentions.analysis: Drummond played well with 7 points and 13 rebounds, but his role is uncertain with Embiid's minutes set to increase.

mentions.name: Adem Bona
mentions.analysis: Bona is struggling and is a drop candidate in 10s, 12s, and 14s.

mentions.name: VJ Edgecombe
mentions.analysis: Edgecombe played 40 minutes and had a well-rounded game, making him worth holding despite potential impact from returning players.

mentions.name: Quentin Grimes
mentions.analysis: Grimes had a good game with 24 points and 5 threes, but his long-term value is uncertain with returning players.

mentions.name: Cedric Coward
mentions.analysis: Coward has been performing well, but his shooting percentages are unsustainable. Worth adding in deeper leagues.

mentions.name: Jalen Wells
mentions.analysis: Wells is struggling and not a must-hold in 12-team leagues.
